title: Outstanding obligations.
bodyText: All outstanding obligations in connection with the operation of the waterworks shall be paid by the board of water supply out of waterworks funds.
bodyHtml: §54-17  Outstanding obligations.  All outstanding obligations in connection with the operation of the waterworks shall be paid by the board of water supply out of waterworks funds. [L 1961, c 155, pt of §1; Supp, §145A-7; HRS §54-17]
